classification.difficultyReason: Read two journeys, convert minute intervals to hours and calculate speeds; interpret a stop and an intersection.

content.prompt: The graph below shows the journey of two friends Algie and Bertie from the Post Office at Walton.

spec.description: Two distance–time journeys with labelled axes, ticks and dashed grid at 10-unit intervals. Bertie is blue; Algie is black.
spec.mathematics: Bertie: (0,0), (20,20), (30,20), (50,50). Algie: straight segment from (10,0) to (40,50). Both axes range from 0 to 50.
spec.answerVisibility: All source journey lines and names are permanent givens; no calculated speeds or intersection annotation are supplied.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What is the average speed in km/h of Bertie for:

children.label: i
children.prompt: the first 20 minutes of his journey?

answer.worked:
Bertie travels $20\text{ km}$ in $20\text{ minutes}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=\frac{20}{60}\text{ h}=\frac13\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{20}{1/3}\\\text{Average speed}&=60\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: ii
children.prompt: the last 20 minutes of his journey?

answer.worked:
The last 20 minutes run from minute 30 to minute 50.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Distance travelled}&=50-20=30\text{ km}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{20}{60}\text{ h}=\frac13\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{30}{1/3}\\\text{Average speed}&=90\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: When and where does Bertie stop and for how long?

answer.short: From 20 to 30 minutes after starting, 20 km from Walton, for 10 minutes.
answer.worked:
Bertie's graph is horizontal at $20\text{ km}$ from minute 20 to minute 30, so he is stationary there.
$$\text{Stopping time}=30-20=10\text{ minutes}.$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: What is Algie’s average speed in km/h?

answer.worked:
Algie travels $50\text{ km}$ from minute 10 to minute 40.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=40-10=30\text{ minutes}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{30}{60}\text{ h}=\frac12\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{50}{1/2}\\\text{Average speed}&=100\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: When and where does Algie pass Bertie?

answer.short: 22 minutes after Bertie starts, 20 km from Walton.
answer.worked: Read the intersection of Algie's rising line and Bertie's horizontal segment. It is at approximately $(22,20)$: 22 minutes after Bertie starts and 20 km from Walton.
